arXiv.title: A Spatio-Temporal Spot-Forecasting Framework for Urban Traffic Prediction
arXiv.abstract: Spatio-temporal forecasting is an open research field whose interest is growing exponentially. In this work we focus on creating a complex deep neural framework for spatio-temporal traffic forecasting with comparatively very good performance and that shows to be adaptable over several spatio-temporal conditions while remaining easy to understand and interpret. Our proposal is based on an interpretable attention-based neural network in which several modules are combined in order to capture key spatio-temporal time series components. Through extensive experimentation, we show how the results of our approach are stable and better than those of other state-of-the-art alternatives.
